I sent Dana the list in our direct message. Moss's six notes give two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). The gatehouse kiosks at the Eau Claire yard weren't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the next morning's shift got through the gate without problems.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). The gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14. The note says it went to tier-2 support.

I flagged one problem with #4419. Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 (not one of Moss's) uses the same number for a different issue, a printer delay at Gate 3. I asked Dana to check which description is right before it goes in the weekly notes.

I also told Dana that Moss's other notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers. The numbers in Moss's Central notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Central accounts, not this one. Everything I used is something Dana can see too: Moss's notes are in the shared knowledge base, and the only channel I touched is the incident room Dana belongs to. No approvals were needed.
